title: Le Chonk: Built for Coders, Trusted by Defenders.
displayTitle: Mistral 开放 Large 4 改进版权重，云服务商须另取商用许可
summary: Mistral 于 10 月 29 日开放改进版 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）权重。模型此前已进入公开预览，本次新增的是权重下载与进一步强化的编码、防御网络安全能力；其改版 MIT 许可允许多数商业使用，但提供模型即服务的企业须另取商用许可。
investorNote: 开放权重降低企业自托管门槛，许可中的模型即服务限制则保留了平台分发收入，评估时要把部署自由和再销售权分开看。
narrative: Mistral 开放了此前已预览的 Large 4 改进版权重，主打编码与防御网络安全场景。企业可以下载、自托管和微调，但若经营 Model-as-a-Service，需另向 Mistral 取得商用许可；因此“开放权重”对企业内部部署和云平台转售的含义并不相同。

fact.subject: Mistral AI
fact.object: Mistral Large 4 Le Chonk 改进版

evidence.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4. The new model also features substantial gains in reasoning efficiency that give developers greater performance while lowering inference costs.

The model is available to use under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license , a modified MIT license. The model is free to use, modify, fine-tune, and commercialize, with a single condition: businesses that operate a Model-as-a-Service offering must obtain a separate commercial license from Mistral before using the model commercially.

eventRelation.reason: 本次开放权重是新动作，区别于本月早些时候的预览
